name: Tamer: King of Dinosaurs
storyline:
Victor Shelby was an ordinary Los Angeles animal control officer until an alien abduction left him stranded on a mysterious world filled with prehistoric predators. He soon discovers that he isn't the only one who has been taken. Women from other worlds have also been brought to this dangerous planet, each with their own past, skills, and reasons to survive.

With no clear way home, Victor and his new companions must learn to work together. They gather resources, craft weapons, build a fortified home, and face increasingly dangerous dinosaurs as they uncover what it takes to survive in this strange new world.

But survival is only the beginning. As Victor earns the trust of his companions, friendships deepen into romance and the group begins to become something more than a collection of strangers. Along the way, Victor discovers that even the planet's deadliest creatures can sometimes be tamed, giving his growing tribe a fighting chance in a world where humanity is far from the top of the food chain.
summary:
Tamer: King of Dinosaurs - an action/adventure game for people of culture who love dinosaurs, adventure, and harem dating sims featuring beautiful alien women. Complete quests, gather resources, and bond with your lovers while keeping your tribe safe on a deadly primitive world.

Play as Victor Shelby, a Los Angeles animal control officer abducted by aliens and stranded on a deadly dinosaur planet where he must help a group of beautiful alien women survive.

Craft and upgrade weapons like spears, clubs and axes to engage dinosaurs in brutal melee combat with your hunting partner, Sheela. Utilize the adrenaline system to unleash special attacks and even special over-the-top, gore-filled executions.

Tamer: King of Dinosaurs offers a gripping story filled with adventure, an engaging story, and romance.
